name: NTP Clock
summary: An ESP32-C3 desk clock with a 7-segment or LCD display, alarm, hourly chime, light sensor and outdoor temperature. It gets its time from the internet and checks in here for its settings.

hw_id.label: WiFi MAC address
hw_id.help: 12 characters, printed by the clock at start-up and by `wifi` on the serial console.

setup_help: Connect the clock's USB cable, open its serial console and paste these three lines. The clock checks in within a minute.

settings.label: WiFi network
settings.help: The name of the WiFi network the clock joins.

settings.label: WiFi password
settings.help: Empty for an open network, otherwise 8 to 64 characters. Never shown again once saved.

settings.label: Name on the network
settings.help: The name the clock gives your router (DHCP host name).

settings.label: WiFi power
settings.help: Transmit power in dBm. Lower it if the clock sits right next to the router.

settings.label: Refused logins before setup mode
settings.help: After this many refused WiFi logins the clock opens its own setup network. 0 = never.

settings.label: Time server
settings.help: The NTP server the clock asks for the time.

settings.label: Ask for the time every
settings.help: Minutes between two time syncs.

settings.label: Time is stale after
settings.help: Minutes without a successful sync before the clock shows the time as stale.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.help: A POSIX time zone string. Pick a place from the list or type your own.

presets.label: Central Europe (Banja Luka, Sarajevo, Belgrade, Zagreb, Berlin, Paris, Rome, Vienna)
Eastern Europe (Athens, Sofia, Bucharest, Helsinki, Kyiv)

settings.label: 24-hour clock
settings.help: Off shows a 12-hour clock.

settings.label: Leading zero
settings.help: Show 07 instead of 7 for the hour.

settings.label: Display type
settings.help: The kind of display wired to the clock. The clock must restart to use a new one.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: Brightness when automatic brightness is off.

settings.label: Automatic brightness
settings.help: Follow the light sensor.

settings.label: Sensor voltage when dark
settings.help: Light sensor voltage of the lowest brightness level.

settings.label: Sensor voltage when bright
settings.help: Light sensor voltage of the highest brightness level.

settings.label: Start-up text
settings.help: Shown when the clock starts. Up to 64 characters; the 7-segment display can only show some letters.

settings.label: Scroll step
settings.help: How fast long text scrolls: milliseconds per step.

settings.label: Clock page
settings.help: How long the time is shown before the next page (7-segment display).

settings.label: Date page
settings.help: 0 = never show the date.

settings.label: Temperature page
settings.help: 0 = never show the temperature.

settings.label: Alarm time page
settings.help: 0 = never show the alarm time.

settings.label: Place name
settings.help: The name shown for the outdoor temperature.

settings.label: Latitude
settings.help: Decimal degrees, north is positive.

settings.label: Longitude
settings.help: Decimal degrees, east is positive.

settings.label: Sound
settings.help: One of the clock's seven sound patterns.

settings.label: Hourly chime
settings.help: Beep every full hour.

settings.label: Status beeps
settings.help: Beeps when WiFi connects and the time syncs.

settings.label: Quiet from
settings.help: No chime and no beeps from this time…

settings.label: Quiet until
settings.help: …until this time.

settings.label: Talks to this server
settings.help: Switched on at the clock itself (cfg set remote on). The server never changes it.

settings.label: Server address
settings.help: Typed into the clock. The server never changes it.

settings.label: Device token
settings.help: Typed into the clock. The server never changes it.

settings.label: Check in every (fallback)
settings.help: Used only when the server gives no interval.

commands.name: sync_time
commands.label: Sync the time now
commands.help: Ask the time server right away.

commands.name: weather_refresh
commands.label: Refresh the temperature
commands.help: Fetch the outdoor temperature right away.

commands.name: alarm_test
commands.label: Play an alarm sound
commands.help: Play one of the seven sounds once.

commands.name: reboot
commands.label: Restart
commands.help: The clock restarts after its next check-in.

commands.name: setup_mode
commands.label: Open setup mode
commands.help: The clock restarts into its own WiFi network for the setup page. It stops checking in here until it is back on your WiFi.

commands.name: cfg_reset
commands.label: Erase all settings
commands.help: The clock forgets everything, including the WiFi login and this server. You will have to set it up again at the clock.

warnings.wifi: If the clock cannot log in to the new network it opens its own setup network after a few refused logins ("Refused logins before setup mode").
